Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I suppose the [Prince and the Page](/book/61) will be out next week, so I enclose a list of the presentation copies. I hope I sent back the last proof, but it was only of the index, so it matters not at all, unless it has caused a delay. It has been a confused week, for the [little girl](/person/1592), after some days of hopeful improvement suddenly lost ground and died early on Thursday morning. The other children have had the disorder favourably and are all well. I hope your party at the Elms are well, and will have a more joyous Christmas than has come to us.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
